Subject: Promo credit waiver and split invoicing question

Hi Rishi —

Thanks again for the demo last week. Quick follow up from our finance team: we run a cohort-based accelerator and promo credits were offered to each startup on sign-up. Two asks:

1) One of our sponsors wants credits to be usable in a shared sandbox environment (not on individual company sub-accounts). Is that something Redwood allows?
2) We need the option to split invoices across sponsor and cohort admin (i.e., apply credits to specific line items, then bill remaining to Spark Foundry). Can you confirm whether Redwood supports split invoicing or a temporary waiver to apply credits beyond the standard sunset date?

Attached is a spreadsheet summarizing the cohort (promo amounts by startup). Happy to jump on a quick call if helpful.

Best,
Emma Liu
Partnerships Manager, Spark Foundry
emma.liu@sparkfoundry.com

Subject: Re: Promo credit waiver and split invoicing question

Emma — thanks for the clear summary and the matrix. Short answers up front:

• Sandbox usage: we can credit a "sponsor-managed" environment but there are policy guardrails (audit trail, per-startup consumption caps, and data isolation options).
• Split invoicing: we can support allocation of credits and split billing for a defined period but it requires a contractual exception (SOW amendment) and finance coordination.

Next steps I propose: Monica (cc'd) can draft an SOW addendum that outlines the sandbox usage model and the billing flow. We'll also need a one-off waiver for the credits' sunset date — that goes through our finance and compliance review. Can you confirm the number of startups and the total promo value you want exempted from the sunset? Also please share the billing contact for Spark Foundry.

Happy to set a 30-minute sync tomorrow to walk through the proposed terms.

- Rishi
Rishi Malhotra
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference

Date: Fri, 2 Apr 2027 11:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Redwood SOW draft and temporary waiver approach

Emma — appreciate the details and the legal note. I've attached a draft SOW addendum that captures:

1) Temporary promo credit exemption: specified list of promo IDs (attached matrix) allowed to be applied to a sponsor-managed sandbox for up to 180 days from grant date.
2) Audit and reporting: monthly consumption exports, per-startup cap enforcement, and a reconciliation CSV we will send to Billing.
3) Billing flow: credits apply against token/compute charges first; Redwood will issue an aggregated invoice to Spark Foundry with line items split as: Promo credits applied (line 1), Sponsor remainder billed to sponsor (line 2), Individual startup overages optionally billed to that startup (line 3) — we can toggle per cohort.
4) Termination and clawback: if sandbox is used for production workloads, the waiver terminates.

Two outstanding items we need from Spark Foundry: formal list of promo IDs (from the matrix) and confirmation that the sandbox is used only for development/testing. Once we have those we can route for internal finance approval and fast-track the waiver.

I'm attaching the SOW addendum and a redlined clause for your counsel. If that looks good we can prepare DocuSign for signatures.

Thanks,
Monica Patel
Head of Commercial Operations, Redwood Inference
monica.patel@redwood.ai
